comment: PROVENANCE (jsntrs-qr9): this group's 55 `token` values were derived in wave 5 from jsonata 2.2.2 and re-probed here — 52 of the 55 are byte-identical to what that engine attaches; the other three (case014, case015, case016) record "" where jsonata 2.2.2 attaches no token at all, so the fixture spells "no token" as the empty string rather than disagreeing about one. The documentation specifies error CODES and never says an error carries a token at all (docs/behaviors.md 2.0.1), so `tests/conformance.rs` reports a token difference instead of failing on one and no NEW token expectation may be added. The `code` is the enforced part.
